lines.text: The death animation in my game was really bad.
lines.note: the old (pre-ragdoll) death from the sniper's POV in hell: a prisoner is shot and plays the stiff canned death
no voice: the old canned death again, grey test map, close up, with a scared reaction gif

lines.text: Yeaeeeeeeeh I needed something better, but if my art didnt make it clear, I'm a programmer, not an animator
lines.note: slow zoom out over the hell pit with the old deaths

lines.text: Luckily my solution actually came from you guys, in an earlier short when i asked for suggestions, this guy gave me the exact solution to my problem. Ragdolls
lines.note: the zoom out continues, a YouTube-style comment card (placeholder) suggesting ragdolls, then the guard shoots a runner on the tower and he ragdolls with momentum ON the word Ragdolls

lines.text: these are pretty janky, but im keeping it that way, because it doesnt effect gameplay, and i think makes it more entertaining
lines.note: a montage of sniper hits ragdolling prisoners, then one freaks out and flies

lines.text: Once i had this, i wanted to use it more. Now when you shove someone, they also ragdoll.
lines.note: melee shoves: a prisoner shoves another and the victim ragdolls

lines.text: And when you reach the tower, you can shove the guard out, and watch them go flying into the pit.
lines.note: runner POV at the tower: shoves the guard out and the guard flies into the pit

lines.text: Let me know what else I should add in the comments
